meanings.en: the crime of forcing someone to have sex against their will
meanings.exampleEn: He was convicted of rape and sent to prison.
meanings.exampleTr: Tecavüzden suçlu bulundu ve hapse gönderildi.

meanings.en: acting too quickly without thinking about the consequences
meanings.exampleEn: Don't make a rash decision that you might regret later.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonradan pişman olabileceğin aceleci bir karar verme.

meanings.en: a series of short sharp knocking sounds, or a baby's toy that makes such a sound
meanings.exampleEn: The baby shook the rattle and laughed.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebek çıngırağı salladı ve güldü.

meanings.en: the damaging or destructive effects of something
meanings.exampleEn: The town still bears the ravages of the war.
meanings.exampleTr: Kasaba hâlâ savaşın tahribatını taşıyor.

meanings.en: something you do or feel in response to an event or situation
meanings.exampleEn: Her first reaction to the news was shock.
meanings.exampleTr: Haberlere ilk tepkisi şok oldu.

meanings.en: quickly and easily, or willingly
meanings.exampleEn: This information is readily available online.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu bilgi internette kolayca bulunabilir.

meanings.en: property in the form of land and buildings
meanings.exampleEn: She made a fortune investing in real estate.
meanings.exampleTr: Gayrimenkule yatırım yaparak servet kazandı.

meanings.en: the moment of suddenly understanding something
meanings.exampleEn: The realization that he was alone hit him hard.
meanings.exampleTr: Yalnız olduğunun farkına varması onu derinden sarstı.

meanings.en: at the back of something
meanings.exampleEn: Passengers should use the rear door of the bus.
meanings.exampleTr: Yolcular otobüsün arka kapısını kullanmalıdır.

meanings.en: to a fairly good degree, or in a fair and sensible way
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel was reasonably priced for the area.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel, bölgeye göre makul fiyatlıydı.

meanings.en: a person who fights against authority or established rules
meanings.exampleEn: The rebels took control of the capital city.
meanings.exampleTr: İsyancılar başkentin kontrolünü ele geçirdi.

meanings.en: refusing to obey rules or authority
meanings.exampleEn: As a teenager he was rebellious and often skipped school.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç yaşta asiydi ve sık sık okulu asardı.

meanings.en: a set of instructions for preparing a particular dish
meanings.exampleEn: This recipe takes only twenty minutes to prepare.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu tarifin hazırlanması sadece yirmi dakika sürüyor.

meanings.en: to think or believe that something is true
meanings.exampleEn: I reckon it will rain later this afternoon.
meanings.exampleTr: Sanırım bu öğleden sonra yağmur yağacak.

meanings.en: the act of knowing someone or something, or public acknowledgement of achievement
meanings.exampleEn: She received an award in recognition of her work.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışmalarının takdiri olarak bir ödül aldı.

meanings.en: to remember something from the past
meanings.exampleEn: I can't recollect exactly where we first met.
meanings.exampleTr: İlk nerede tanıştığımızı tam olarak hatırlayamıyorum.

meanings.en: a memory of something from the past
meanings.exampleEn: My recollection of that day is rather vague.
meanings.exampleTr: O güne dair anım oldukça belirsiz.

meanings.en: good enough to be suggested to others
meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant is highly recommendable for its seafood.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoran, deniz ürünleri için kesinlikle tavsiye edilebilir.

meanings.en: a suggestion that something is good or suitable
meanings.exampleEn: I bought the book on my teacher's recommendation.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitabı öğretmenimin tavsiyesiyle aldım.

meanings.en: to think again about a decision in order to change it
meanings.exampleEn: Please reconsider your decision before it is too late.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok geç olmadan kararını yeniden gözden geçir lütfen.

meanings.en: activities done for enjoyment when you are not working
meanings.exampleEn: The park offers many opportunities for recreation.
meanings.exampleTr: Park, dinlence için birçok olanak sunuyor.

meanings.en: shaped like a rectangle
meanings.exampleEn: The table has a long rectangular top.
meanings.exampleTr: Masanın uzun, dikdörtgen bir yüzeyi var.

meanings.en: to do something again because it was not done well
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher asked me to redo the assignment.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen ödevi yeniden yapmamı istedi.

meanings.en: not needed because it is more than necessary
meanings.exampleEn: The editor removed several redundant words from the text.
meanings.exampleTr: Editör metinden birkaç gereksiz kelime çıkardı.

meanings.en: a tall plant that grows in or near water
meanings.exampleEn: Ducks were hiding among the reeds by the lake.
meanings.exampleTr: Ördekler gölün kenarındaki sazların arasında saklanıyordu.

meanings.en: a mention of something, or a source of information
meanings.exampleEn: She made a brief reference to her previous job.
meanings.exampleTr: Önceki işine kısa bir atıfta bulundu.

meanings.en: the thing that a word or expression refers to
meanings.exampleEn: In this sentence, the referent of the pronoun is unclear.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu cümlede zamirin göndergesi belirsizdir.

meanings.en: a factory where a substance such as oil or sugar is purified
meanings.exampleEn: The oil refinery employs thousands of workers.
meanings.exampleTr: Petrol rafinerisi binlerce işçi istihdam ediyor.

meanings.en: thinking carefully and quietly, or able to reflect light
meanings.exampleEn: She was in a reflective mood after the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıdan sonra düşünceli bir ruh hâlindeydi.

meanings.en: a change made to improve a system or institution
meanings.exampleEn: The government promised major reform of the education system.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet eğitim sisteminde büyük bir reform sözü verdi.

meanings.en: a part of a song that is repeated, especially at the end of each verse
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone joined in singing the refrain.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkes nakaratı söylemeye katıldı.

meanings.en: the act of updating or reloading something
meanings.exampleEn: A quick refresh of the page showed the new messages.
meanings.exampleTr: Sayfanın hızlı bir yenilemesi yeni mesajları gösterdi.

meanings.en: a safe place where you are protected from danger
meanings.exampleEn: They sought refuge from the storm in a nearby cave.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtınadan korunmak için yakındaki bir mağaraya sığındılar.

meanings.en: a person who has been forced to leave their country to escape danger
meanings.exampleEn: Thousands of refugees crossed the border last month.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen ay binlerce mülteci sınırı geçti.

meanings.en: to prove that a statement or idea is wrong
meanings.exampleEn: The scientist was able to refute the theory with new evidence.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanı teoriyi yeni kanıtlarla çürütmeyi başardı.

meanings.en: respect or admiration for someone, or a particular aspect
meanings.exampleEn: She is held in high regard by her colleagues.
meanings.exampleTr: Meslektaşları tarafından büyük saygı görüyor.

meanings.en: without being affected by something; in spite of it
meanings.exampleEn: He continued with the plan regardless of the risks.
meanings.exampleTr: Risklere aldırmadan plana devam etti.

meanings.en: a type of popular music that originated in Jamaica
meanings.exampleEn: They danced all night to reggae music.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün gece reggae müziği eşliğinde dans ettiler.

meanings.en: a government, especially an authoritarian one
meanings.exampleEn: The country suffered under a brutal military regime.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke acımasız bir askeri rejim altında acı çekti.

meanings.en: a feeling of sadness about something you wish had been different
meanings.exampleEn: She expressed deep regret for her past mistakes.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçmiş hatalarından dolayı derin bir pişmanlık dile getirdi.

meanings.en: used to express that something is unfortunate
meanings.exampleEn: Regrettably, the concert had to be cancelled.
meanings.exampleTr: Ne yazık ki konser iptal edilmek zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: to control an activity by means of rules
meanings.exampleEn: The government plans to regulate the banking industry more strictly.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet bankacılık sektörünü daha sıkı düzenlemeyi planlıyor.

meanings.en: a practice of a performance before it is given in public
meanings.exampleEn: The final rehearsal went smoothly without any mistakes.
meanings.exampleTr: Son prova hiç hata olmadan sorunsuz geçti.

meanings.en: to make something stronger or more effective
meanings.exampleEn: The walls were reinforced with steel to prevent collapse.
meanings.exampleTr: Duvarlar çökmeyi önlemek için çelikle güçlendirildi.

meanings.en: the act of making something stronger, or extra support
meanings.exampleEn: The troops waited for reinforcement before advancing.
meanings.exampleTr: Birlikler ilerlemeden önce takviye beklediler.

meanings.en: the act of refusing to accept someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: He felt hurt by the rejection of his proposal.
meanings.exampleTr: Teklifinin reddedilmesi onu üzdü.

meanings.en: to join something again after leaving it
meanings.exampleEn: After the break, she rejoined her teammates on the field.
meanings.exampleTr: Aradan sonra, sahada takım arkadaşlarına yeniden katıldı.

meanings.en: connected to something, or belonging to the same family
meanings.exampleEn: The two events are closely related to each other.
meanings.exampleTr: İki olay birbiriyle yakından bağlantılı.

meanings.en: the state of being relative, or Einstein's theory in physics
meanings.exampleEn: Einstein's theory of relativity changed modern physics.
meanings.exampleTr: Einstein'ın görelilik teorisi modern fiziği değiştirdi.

meanings.en: the state of being free from tension and worry
meanings.exampleEn: Yoga is a great way to find relaxation after work.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoga, işten sonra rahatlama bulmanın harika bir yoludur.

meanings.en: a race in which team members take turns, or a device passing on signals
meanings.exampleEn: Our team won the 400-metre relay at the championship.
meanings.exampleTr: Takımımız şampiyonada 400 metre bayrak yarışını kazandı.

meanings.en: closely connected to the subject being discussed
meanings.exampleEn: Please provide all the relevant documents for the application.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen başvuru için tüm ilgili belgeleri sağlayın.

meanings.en: an object that has survived from the past
meanings.exampleEn: The museum displays ancient relics from Roman times.
meanings.exampleTr: Müze, Roma dönemine ait antik kalıntıları sergiliyor.

meanings.en: a feeling of relaxation when worry or pain stops
meanings.exampleEn: It was a great relief to hear that everyone was safe.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesin güvende olduğunu duymak büyük bir rahatlamaydı.

meanings.en: to make pain or a problem less severe
meanings.exampleEn: This medicine should relieve the pain in a few minutes.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ilaç birkaç dakika içinde ağrıyı hafifletmeli.

meanings.en: feeling happy because something unpleasant has stopped or did not happen
meanings.exampleEn: She was relieved to find her lost keys.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayıp anahtarlarını bulduğunda rahatlamıştı.

meanings.en: unwilling to do something and therefore slow to do it
meanings.exampleEn: He was reluctant to admit that he had made a mistake.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir hata yaptığını kabul etmeye isteksizdi.

meanings.en: still left after others have gone or been used
meanings.exampleEn: We spent the remaining money on souvenirs.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalan parayı hatıra eşyalarına harcadık.

meanings.en: the parts of something that are left after the rest has gone
meanings.exampleEn: Archaeologists discovered the remains of an ancient city.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkeologlar antik bir şehrin kalıntılarını keşfetti.

meanings.en: something that you say, giving an opinion or comment
meanings.exampleEn: He made a rude remark about her appearance.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun görünümü hakkında kaba bir söz söyledi.

meanings.en: to a degree that is unusual or surprising
meanings.exampleEn: The two brothers are remarkably similar in appearance.
meanings.exampleTr: İki kardeş görünüş olarak dikkat çekici biçimde benzer.

meanings.en: something that makes you remember something
meanings.exampleEn: She set a reminder on her phone for the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı için telefonuna bir hatırlatma kurdu.

meanings.en: an arrangement to rent something, or the amount paid
meanings.exampleEn: The car rental costs fifty dollars per day.
meanings.exampleTr: Araç kiralama günde elli dolara mal oluyor.

meanings.en: to organize something again in a different way
meanings.exampleEn: The company decided to reorganize its sales department.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket satış departmanını yeniden düzenlemeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: a new coat of paint applied to something
meanings.exampleEn: The old fence needs a complete repaint before summer.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski çitin yazdan önce baştan sona yeniden boyanmaya ihtiyacı var.

meanings.en: all the works or skills a performer or person is able to do
meanings.exampleEn: The pianist has a wide repertoire of classical pieces.
meanings.exampleTr: Piyanistin geniş bir klasik parça repertuarı var.

meanings.en: the act of doing or saying something again
meanings.exampleEn: Learning a language requires a lot of repetition.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir dil öğrenmek çok fazla tekrar gerektirir.

meanings.en: a person or thing that takes the place of another
meanings.exampleEn: We are looking for a replacement for the broken part.
meanings.exampleTr: Kırık parça için bir yedek arıyoruz.

meanings.en: an exact copy of something, especially a smaller one
meanings.exampleEn: The museum sells a replica of the famous statue.
meanings.exampleTr: Müze, ünlü heykelin bir replikasını satıyor.

meanings.en: to control or hold back a feeling or desire
meanings.exampleEn: She tried hard to repress her anger during the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı sırasında öfkesini bastırmaya çok çalıştı.
